# Lua expression captures

Five frozen cases cover arithmetic, comparisons, concatenation, one-based Lua
indexing, direct dotted paths, local bindings, long strings, typed values,
array/map conversion, JSON resources, loops, and retained helper callbacks.
Each retains a complete evaluated model and editable package. Source hashes and
package fingerprints are recorded in capture manifests.

These cases require explicit Lua enablement. They use the existing output paths;
the captures do not establish real-Word visual review.

Five native PDF pages compare exactly at 144 DPI and have been visually inspected.
The callback case deliberately retains the literal `.0.name` suffix after a
content reference; numeric path segments belong in expressions.
